convert_dataset_tfds: convert a TensorFlow dataset from one file format to another format using the convert_dataset function
convert_metadata_tfds: convert dataset metadata to a target file format and write it to a directory
get_all_shard_instructions_tfds: get all shard conversion instructions for every split in a TensorFlow dataset
create_shard_instructions_tfds: create shard conversion instructions from input and output filename templates for a given number of shards
run_shard_convert_tfds: run shard conversion by reading examples from an input file adapter and writing them via an output file adapter
